title: A Mobile App-Based Study to Evaluate Disease Burden and Treatment Patterns in Immunoglobulin A Nephropathy (IgAN) in the US
official: A Mobile App-Based, Prospective, Observational Study to Evaluate Disease Burden and Treatment Patterns in Immunoglobulin A Nephropathy (IgAN) in the US
summary: The study aims to longitudinally capture the full spectrum of symptoms, treatment utilization, and overall health-related quality of life (HRQoL) experienced by Immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) patients and their caregivers.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of IgAN, regardless of symptom or treatment history
* Adult aged 18 or older; adult caregiver to an adult patient aged 18 or older; or adult caregiver to a pediatric patient under 18 years of age
* US-based with a proficient understanding of and ability to read the English language

Exclusion Criteria:

None
